events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on this day in 1943.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young today! Raise a glass to the legendary Mick Jagger, still strutting his stuff and proving rock and roll never gets old.

events.title: MTV launched, changing music forever
events.blurb: On this day in 1981, MTV went live, broadcasting its first music video: The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

angles.name: Video Killed The Radio Star
angles.copy: Remember a world before music videos? On this day in '81, MTV launched, kicking off a visual revolution with The Buggles. Did video really kill the radio star? We're still here!

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring classics like 'Live Forever' and 'Supersonic'.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago this month, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and Britpop changed forever. What's your favourite track from the album that launched a thousand singalongs?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, three days of peace and music, took place from August 15-18, 1969, on Max Yasgur's farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. An unforgettable moment in cultural history.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977, leaving behind an unparalleled legacy as the King of Rock and Roll.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music and charisma continue to captivate generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and that famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The album cover that launched a thousand theories. This month marks the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' – a masterpiece recorded in their final sessions.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as the voice and heart of The Pretenders. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, the distinctive frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Fifty-four today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Love him or loathe him, you can't deny his impact on British music. As you were!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, from his album of the same name.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago this month, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was born on this day in 1940 and would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Eighty-seven years young! Happy birthday to the brilliant John Cleese, a true titan of British comedy. From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs.
